title: Clients
purpose: Find the laboratory’s clients and open their account details, people, projects and recent work. Clients own projects; projects group chains of custody and received samples.
summary: The laboratory's clients. Open one to see its contacts, projects, recent work and portal accounts.

tasks.title: Find a client
steps: Type a name, account code, contact, email or city in [[Search]] and select [[Apply]].
Select the client's name to open its record.

tasks.title: Add a client
steps: Select [[New client]], enter at least the name, and save. Then add its projects.

tasks.title: List clients in one state
steps: Open [[More filters]], choose the [[State]] and select [[Apply]].

good_to_know: An inactive client cannot receive new intake. Its existing records stay readable.
Search does not look at phone numbers, additional contacts, report instructions or notes.
Selecting an email address opens your email application. Nothing is sent from here.
Many clients can be created or changed at once with Spreadsheet import under Setup.

items.label: Search
items.description: Matches client name, account code, primary contact name, primary email or city. It does not search phone, addresses, additional contacts, report instructions or notes.

items.label: Status
items.description: All statuses/All includes active and inactive clients. Active or Inactive filters the client flag.

items.label: State
items.description: More filters: Any state or one state of the client’s mailing address (a list of the 50 states, the District of Columbia and the territories, shown by name). Clients with no recorded state do not match a chosen state.

items.label: New client
items.description: Project managers and administrators create a client before creating its projects.

items.label: Client row link
items.description: Opens the client record for any authorized staff member.

items.label: Email link
items.description: Opens your email application; this page does not send an email.

items.label: Spreadsheet import
items.description: Project managers can also create or change many clients at once from a CSV file under Setup → Spreadsheet import. The file identifies each client by its account code; contacts are not imported.

items.label: Client
items.description: Client organization name; default sort is name ascending.

items.label: Account code
items.description: The laboratory’s short code for the client, or a dash. Sortable.

items.label: Status
items.description: Inactive blocks new intake, while existing records remain readable.

items.label: Contact
items.description: Primary contact name; additional people are on the client record.

items.label: Email
items.description: Primary contact email, or a dash when absent.

items.label: Phone
items.description: Primary phone, or a dash. Not sortable.

items.label: City / State
items.description: Mailing address city and state, or a dash. Each is sortable.

items.label: Payment terms
items.description: Initially hidden. Chosen payment terms, or a dash, followed by PO required when the client requires a purchase order. Not sortable.

items.label: Report instructions
items.description: Initially hidden text, shortened to 80 characters in the list. Open the client for the full text. Not sortable.

sections.title: Table controls
paragraphs: Active laboratory staff can read this list; client portal accounts cannot. Invalid filters show errors and no rows until corrected or cleared. Invalid page sizes are refused. No-match and no-record empty states provide different next steps. Inactive records remain part of historical searches.

items.label: Apply
items.description: Combines a case-insensitive contains search and selected filters across the complete record set; returns to page 1.

items.label: More filters
items.description: Opens the State filter and remains open when it is active or invalid.

items.label: Clear all / filter chips
items.description: Clear all restores the unfiltered URL and default sort. Remove one chip to clear that criterion, preserving the others and returning to page 1.

items.label: Column headings
items.description: Linked headings sort all matching records, not just this page. Record ID breaks ties. Unsupported sort values use the default.

items.label: Columns
items.description: Show, hide or reorder optional columns. The identifying column remains visible. Browser-local preferences do not change data, search or sort; reset restores default columns.

items.label: Rows per page
items.description: 25 by default; choose 25, 50 or 100. Changing size returns to page 1. Use Show when automatic submission is unavailable.

items.label: Pagination
items.description: First, Previous, Next and Last retain filters and sort. The footer gives the visible range and total matching count.

items.label: Column checkboxes
items.description: Changes apply immediately. Check to show an optional column or uncheck to hide it. Always shown columns are fixed.

items.label: Move column up / down
items.description: Moves an optional column within the displayed order; the first/last position disables the unavailable move. You can also drag movable table headers.

items.label: Reset columns
items.description: Restores this table’s default order and visibility for your account.

items.label: Done / Close
items.description: Closes the dialog; layout changes have already been applied and saved locally. No laboratory record is changed.
